issues.quote: A lion can roar, but it cannot purr like a house cat. A cheetah can purr, but it cannot roar. In fact, scientists say no cat can both purr and roar!
issues.problem: The source gives the lion-can't-purr idea as only a hypothesis, based on a bone in the throat (the hyoid). Other scientists argued that this bone does not decide whether a cat can purr. The snow leopard is also a roaring-group cat that purrs. The script states it as settled fact and says all scientists agree.
issues.fix: A lion can roar, and a cheetah can purr. Scientists have long thought that no cat can do both, but they still argue about the details!
